tool.name: CpG Harmonisation Stage 1: Noob Background Correction
tool.description: Within-array background correction and single dye-bias adjustment (minfi::preprocessNoob)
tool.command: #for $counter, $input in enumerate($files_red): #set $redname = str( getattr( $input, 'element_identifier', 'sample' ) ).replace( '/', '-' ).replace( '\t', '-' ) ln -s $input ./${redname} && #end for #for $counter, $input in enumerate($files_grn): #set $grnname = str( getattr( $input, 'element_identifier', 'sample' ) ).replace( '/', '-' ).replace( '\t', '-' ) ln -s $input ./${grnname} && #end for Rscript '$stage1_script'

configfiles.configfile:
require('minfi', quietly = TRUE) options(warn = -1)
RGSet <- read.metharray(list.files(pattern='_Red.idat')) #load .IDAT files, mixed 450K/EPIC supported
MSet.noob <- preprocessNoob(RGSet, dyeMethod = 'single') #within-array background correction + single dye-bias adjustment
qc <- getQC(MSet.noob) ## Round to 6 significant figures: raw double precision in mMed/uMed varies ## in the far decimal places across R/Bioconductor point releases (e.g. ## different BLAS backends), which made byte-exact test comparisons fail ## despite effectively identical values. qc\$mMed <- signif(qc\$mMed, 6) qc\$uMed <- signif(qc\$uMed, 6) write.table(qc, '$qctab') png('$qcpng') plotQC(qc) dev.off()
RSet <- ratioConvert(MSet.noob, what = 'both', keepCN = TRUE) GRSet <- mapToGenome(RSet)
save(GRSet, file = '$grset_out')

param.name: files_red
param.label: Red .IDAT files
param.help: Red .IDAT files - unmethylated signal intensity read in the red channel. One per sample; mixed 450K/EPIC samples supported.

param.name: files_grn
param.label: Green .IDAT files
param.help: Green .IDAT files - methylated signal intensity read in the green channel. Must match Red files 1:1 by sample.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Stage 1 of the cross-array (450K/EPIC) harmonisation pipeline. Loads raw Red/Green .IDAT channel files and applies minfi's Noob (normal-exponential out-of-band) background correction with single-sample dye-bias adjustment (``preprocessNoob(dyeMethod='single')``), producing a within-array corrected ``GenomicRatioSet``. This runs independently of array type, so 450K and EPIC samples can be processed through this stage before being combined downstream.
***Inputs***
*Series of .IDAT files*: matching red and green .idat file for each sample on the chip intensity data.
***Outputs***
*Stage 1 GenomicRatioSet*: an ``.rda`` file containing a ``GRSet`` object, consumed by Stage 2 (cross-platform quantile normalisation).
*Quality Control Report and Plot*: log median intensity in the methylated (M) and unmethylated (U) channels, as produced by ``minfi::getQC``/``plotQC``.
